passage.text: Thank you for your email regarding your stay at the Blue Bay Hotel.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər jʊr ˈiːmeɪl rɪˈɡɑːrdɪŋ jʊr ˈsteɪ ət ðə ˈbluː ˈbeɪ hoʊˈtɛl.

passage.text: We are very sorry that your stay was so disappointing.
passage.reading: wiː ər ˈvɛri ˈsɑːri ðæt jʊr ˈsteɪ wʌz soʊ ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntɪŋ.

passage.text: As a valued customer, you should always receive the best service from us.
passage.reading: əz ə ˈvæljuːd ˈkʌstəmər, juː ʃʊd ˈɔːlweɪz rɪˈsiːv ðə ˈbɛst ˈsɜːrvɪs frəm ʌs.

passage.text: We have spoken to the hotel manager, and he agrees that the description on our website was inaccurate.
passage.reading: wiː hæv ˈspoʊkən tə ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈmænɪdʒər, ənd hiː əˈɡriːz ðæt ðə dɪˈskrɪpʃən ɑːn aʊr ˈwɛbsaɪt wʌz ɪnˈækjərət.

passage.text: The description has now been changed, and it clearly states which rooms have a sea view.
passage.reading: ðə dɪˈskrɪpʃən hæz ˈnaʊ bɪn ˈtʃeɪndʒd, ənd ɪt ˈklɪrli ˈsteɪts ˈwɪtʃ ˈruːmz ˈhæv ə ˈsiː ˈvjuː.

passage.text: The manager has also apologized for the behavior of his staff.
passage.reading: ðə ˈmænɪdʒər hæz ˈɔːlsoʊ əˈpɑːlədʒaɪzd fər ðə bɪˈheɪvjər əv hɪz ˈstæf.

passage.text: This was a very unfortunate situation, and we understand why you were upset.
passage.reading: ðɪs wʌz ə ˈvɛri ʌnˈfɔːrtʃənət ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən, ənd wiː ˌʌndərˈstænd ˈwaɪ juː wɜːr ˌʌpˈsɛt.

passage.text: We would like to offer you a refund of forty percent of the price, which is two thousand four hundred baht.
passage.reading: wiː wʊd ˈlaɪk tu ˈɔːfər juː ə ˈriːfʌnd əv ˈfɔːrti pərˈsɛnt əv ðə ˈpraɪs, wɪtʃ ɪz ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈfɔːr ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.

passage.text: In addition, we will add a credit of one thousand baht to your account with us.
passage.reading: ɪn əˈdɪʃən, wiː wɪl ˈæd ə ˈkrɛdɪt əv ˈwʌn ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt tə jʊr əˈkaʊnt wɪð ʌs.

passage.text: You can use this credit for any booking on our website in the next twelve months.
passage.reading: juː kən ˈjuːz ðɪs ˈkrɛdɪt fər ˈɛni ˈbʊkɪŋ ɑːn aʊr ˈwɛbsaɪt ɪn ðə ˈnɛkst ˈtwɛlv ˈmʌnθs.

passage.text: The refund will be sent to your bank account within seven days.
passage.reading: ðə ˈriːfʌnd wɪl bi ˈsɛnt tə jʊr ˈbæŋk əˈkaʊnt wɪˈðɪn ˈsɛvən ˈdeɪz.

passage.text: We will do everything we can to ensure that this does not happen again.
passage.reading: wiː wɪl ˈduː ˈɛvriθɪŋ wiː ˈkæn tu ɪnˈʃʊr ðæt ðɪs dʌz ˈnɑːt ˈhæpən əˈɡɛn.

passage.text: From now on, we will check all hotel descriptions more carefully.
passage.reading: frəm ˈnaʊ ˈɑːn, wiː wɪl ˈtʃɛk ˈɔːl hoʊˈtɛl dɪˈskrɪpʃənz ˈmɔːr ˈkɛrfəli.

passage.text: Thank you for your patience, and we hope to welcome you again soon.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər jʊr ˈpeɪʃəns, ənd wiː ˈhoʊp tə ˈwɛlkəm juː əˈɡɛn ˈsuːn.
